context:
Goal: PR 3020 (a cloud session reinstalls when main's hooks moved) is handed in under main's review rule, and no failed check is quietly forgotten.
Problem (rule): the first fix check on head 4c40d80e FAILED (caseK14 red, a test-helper gap in the lane's own merge resolution, fixed in head 9f8d1ead); the second fix check on 9f8d1ead PASSED and is the only one posted (review record comment 6891202935). Main's rule reads "A fix after a FAIL fix verifier gets the fresh full review ... not a fix verifier", and no ruling of yours covers a passing fix check after an earlier failed one, so only you can say which reading holds.
Based on (record): docs/decisions/pr-review-record.md line 131 on main (triage read it at 01:42 CST): "One fix verifier per record. A fix after a FAIL fix verifier gets the fresh full review in The review a changed head owes, not a fix verifier. After a PASS fix verifier, a further fix verifier over a new head is accepted (owner item 741). A clean merge of main takes none." Line 137: a FAIL fix verifier line on the newest earlier record refuses the new fix check. The lane's FAIL was never posted, so the merge tool sees only the PASS and would accept it; the rule's text, not the tool, is what is in question.
Based on (ruling): your 18:35 CST Nov 13 ruling (R9, filed as r9): a fix after a pass is checked by a fix verifier and its pass ends review. It does not say whether that holds after a failed fix check; ruling own-833-a-done-at-fix-check marks the failed-then-fixed case unmeasured. Item 858 asks a nearby question (a passing fix verifier with no round recorded at its head).
Based on (read): triage read PR 3020 on GitHub at 01:44 CST: open draft, head 9f8d1eadc103, mergeable state unstable, base db3134aba78d (main has moved on since); triage did not read the review record or the lane lint.
Departs from: main reads a fix after a FAIL fix verifier as owing a fresh full review; option a lets one PASS fix check stand after an earlier unposted FAIL, which is a looser reading of that rule and needs your ruling. It widens no shared tool.
Who recommends what: the lane (cloud-hooks-stale-copy) recommends a; the coordinator recommends b, because the text on main says a fix after a FAIL fix verifier gets the fresh full review, so a PASS fix check after an earlier FAIL does not stand under it as written; b is the route given to PRs 3465 and 3472 (one fresh Sonnet read of the live head). Option a would be a new ruling only you can give. Only the coordinator's pick is starred.
Meanwhile: the lane lint is running and the lane hands in to its parent; nothing is parked on this answer.
Update 02:49 CST Nov 15: the lane ran the fresh full review (Sonnet, PASS at head 7f71cf29, relayed by the coordinator, not read by triage); the coordinator counts that review as the tool's fix check (as #2870 did). That reading of the record rule is unruled; the question stays open for you.

options.gain: No extra reviewer run; the FAIL was a test-helper gap in the lane's own merge resolution, fixed before any record.
options.how: PR 3020 is handed in on the PASS fix check at head 9f8d1ead. The earlier FAIL is named in the PR and its note, never posted as a record.
options.label: The posted fix-check PASS stands (recommended by the lane)
options.lose: A failed fix check is left out of the record, and main's text (a fix after a FAIL fix verifier gets the fresh full review) would need a new ruling that names this case.

options.gain: Follows main's text as written; no new ruling; no failed check is forgotten.
options.how: One Sonnet reviewer reads the live head in full and posts the rounds again with no Fix check line, as the rule's text says; the same route PRs 3465 and 3472 took.
options.label: Run one fresh full review at head 9f8d1ead (recommended by the coordinator)
options.lose: One more reviewer run on a head that already passed a fix check.
